It has gone that the proper method of knowledge is to obtain it from authority. This method
is accepted as a universal truth, but only the one who argues in vain speaks against it. For example, modern spacecraft fly in the sky, and when scientists
say that they travel to the other side of the moon, people blindly accept these stories
because they have accepted modern scientists as evidence (authority). The common man believes whatever the official says. But they are taught not to believe in Vedic truths. If they accept it, they interpret it differently.
Every person wants to have a direct experience of Vedic knowledge,
but foolishly he denies it. ©. This means that
a misguided person can trust one proof, which is the scientist, but he
rejects the proof of the Vedas. This is the result, that people have declined. Here, an official person has described Shri Krishna as the original God and the first Narayan.
